observations: Photo 0 shows a black Canon DSLR camera with a lens attached, held in hand. The camera body has 'Canon' and 'EOS 1300D' clearly visible on the top right. The lens has a 'Canon' logo and focus distance markings (18-24, 35, 55).

Photo 1 shows the top and front of the camera, with the mode dial, shutter button, and hot shoe visible. The lens barrel has 'Canon' and focal length markings. The camera appears to be in good physical condition with no visible cracks or dents.
The camera is not shown powered on, and no screen or menu is visible. No accessories (battery, charger, strap) are shown.
The background is plain white, suggesting a studio or controlled lighting setup.

claims.claim: This Canon EOS 1300D DSLR Camera is as clean and New like a new one from the Box it was not used for...
claims.evidence: Photos show no signs of use, but no proof of original packaging or full condition. The camera appears clean, but 'new like a new one from the box' cannot be verified remotely.

claims.claim: Shutter count under 5,000, no fungus or scratch on the lens. Original battery and charger, never repaired.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on or have functional issues (e.g., screen, shutter, lens, battery).
risks.proof: Video or photo of the camera powered on, showing the LCD screen and menu navigation.

risks.risk: Lens may have internal fungus, scratches, or damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially at the front and rear elements, under bright light.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lens with potential internal damage

risks.risk: Camera may be missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, lens cap).
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out.

risks.risk: Shutter count may be high (e.g., over 50,000 shots), indicating heavy use.
risks.proof: Photo of the shutter count display on the camera screen or a screenshot from a shutter count tool.

proof_requests: Video or photo of the camera powered on, showing the LCD screen and menu navigation.
Close-up photo of the lens glass, especially at the front and rear elements, under bright light.
Photo showing all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, lens cap).
Photo of the shutter count display on the camera screen or a screenshot from a shutter count tool.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
